findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 8 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 67 questions numbered 1-67; by section: 8.1 5, 8.2 4, 8.3 5, 8.4 2, 8.5 2, 8.6 3, 8.7 4, 8.8 10, 8.9 7, 8.10 1, 8.11 2, 8.12 4, 8.13 4, 8.14 4, 8.15 2, 8.16 8.

Covers sections 8.1-8.16 in order; comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use values changed from the book's sample problems and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (shift to the right when products increase, Kc for BiCl₃ hydrolysis without solid BiOCl, SO₃ and temperature, Kp = Kn(P/N)^Δn, propanone Kc unit mol⁻¹ dm³).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
